question: What digital photos must an Express Entry applicant provide?

claims.text: Digital photos meeting IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications must be provided.
claims.quote: Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

claims.text: Submitted digital photos that fail IRCC permanent resident card photo specifications do not meet Express Entry completeness requirements.
claims.quote: Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

basis: The applicant submitted a digital photo inspection document (case ID 168fdffa85e7d011360ab2b4cd6c5449) for the e-APR digital photo slot.
The submitted document records photo dimensions of 30 mm x 40 mm, a pixel resolution of 240 x 320 px, and a file size of 42 KB.
The document contains an explicit failure narrative on page 2 stating 'CRITICAL SPECIFICATION FAILURE: failed mandatory dimensions and resolution validation.'

The submitted photo fails IRCC permanent resident card photo specifications, which mandate frame dimensions of 50 mm x 70 mm, a pixel resolution between 715 x 1000 px and 2000 x 2800 px, and a file size not exceeding 4 MB.
